claims.claim: There are six referral columns on the Patient Intake board.
Creating a patient (from Add New Referral or from the Fax Review Queue) always places the referral in New Referrals, and the patient record is created as Active.
You move cards between columns by dragging them on the board; any column can be dragged to Non-Admit (and New Referrals → Info Needed/Financial, → Ready for Assignment by drag).

checks.note: the drop target column becomes the status; no transition table restricts it

claims.claim: Ready for Assignment → Assigned: drag the card, then use Assign on the card to pick a provider. A toast prompts you to select a provider to complete assignment.

checks.pattern: toast.info("Please select a provider to complete assignment");

checks.note: the Assign button would need to show on Assigned cards for 'drag, then use Assign'

claims.finding: Dragging a card to Assigned opens the provider-assignment dialog automatically (frontend/src/pages/Referrals.tsx:2265-2281) along with the toast. The Assign button only appears on Ready for Assignment cards (:546); Assigned cards show Schedule instead (:556). Closing the dialog without picking a provider moves the card back to its previous column (:2793-2810).
claims.proposed_text: Drag the card to Assigned (a provider dialog opens and a toast asks you to select a provider), or click Assign on a Ready for Assignment card. If you close the dialog without choosing a provider, the card goes back to its previous column.

proposed_checks.pattern: // If moving to ASSIGNED, open assignment dialog
"Provider assignment cancelled - reverting to previous status"

claims.claim: Assigning does not create the patient and does not remove the card from Referral Intake (card stays on the board; schedule from Fleet Calendar).

checks.note: the diagram says the card stays on the board

claims.finding: Assigning updates the existing patient row and keeps the card in Assigned. But the card does not stay indefinitely: after a visit is booked (status SCHEDULED, still shown under Assigned) and that appointment is more than 7 days past, it is filtered off the board (Referrals.tsx:2002-2006). Assigned cards also have their own Schedule button (:556-580), so Fleet Calendar is not the only place to book.
claims.proposed_text: Assigning does not create the patient. The card stays in Assigned; book the first visit with Schedule on the card or from Fleet Calendar. Once that booked visit is more than 7 days in the past, the card drops off the board.

claims.claim: The Fax Review Queue is a separate page, not a column or a status on this board.
There is no intake_coordinator role — the intake-oriented role in Medipyxis is Referral Coordinator.
